name: Rendered starting XI is a structured list of distinct named rows
description: When a visitor opens the Lineups panel on a match page, the home team's starting XI renders as a list of distinct player rows each carrying a shirt number and a name, rather than one concatenated blob of text, confirming the data is structured in the DOM.

planSteps.description: Read the first match id from the response
Navigate to /match/<first-id> using the captured id
Open the Lineups tab or scroll to the lineups region
Locate the home team's starting XI list
Verify the home team's starting XI renders as at least eleven distinct player rows, each containing a shirt number and a non-empty player name as separate readable text
